01.task_description: This task is a visual shape-matching exercise. The input is a clean white worksheet titled 'Shape Matching', showing colorful objects on the left and geometric shapes on the right. The video model should only draw connecting lines between matching pairs, without moving, resizing, or altering any objects. The background must remain completely white and unchanged. The animation should only show the smooth drawing of lines gradually appearing from left to right.

scoring_criteria.description: 1 point per correct line. No points for wrong or missing connections.
Lines should appear smoothly from left to right. Deduct 1–2 points if lines jump, flicker, or are drawn instantaneously.
Objects and shapes must remain completely still. Deduct points if any movement, rotation, or resizing occurs.
Background must stay white, clean, and consistent. Deduct 0.5–1 point for noise, color shifts, or artifacts.
The animation of line drawing should be temporally coherent. Deduct 0.5–1 point if frames are discontinuous or timing is irregular.

01.final_score_formula: Final_Score = Accuracy(0–4) + Line_Behavior(0–2) + Object_Stability(0–2) + Visual_Cleanliness(0–1) + Temporal_Consistency(0–1)
evaluation_notes: For automatic evaluation, use frame differencing and contour or shape-region matching to verify the correctness of connections.
For human evaluation, check each connection visually to confirm correct object–shape mapping and stability.
Any new elements, text, or extra motion results in deductions under cleanliness and stability criteria.
